25.2V Lithium Ion Battery
=========================

.. include:: ../_templates/constants.rst

**Datasheet:** :raw-html:`<br />`
`25.2V Lithium Ion Battery Datasheet <battery_datasheet>`_


**Features:** :raw-html:`<br />`
**Voltage:** 25.2V Lithium Ion :raw-html:`<br />`
**Cells:** EVE 21700 (15mΩ@1kHz) :raw-html:`<br />`
**Discharge Current:** 40A Continuous / 60A Max (1 Second) :raw-html:`<br />`
**Max Power:** 1,440+ Max Watts :raw-html:`<br />`
**Charge Compatibility:** 5A Max Charge (3A Charger Included) :raw-html:`<br />`
**Protection:** Complete battery protection (overcharge/undercharge) :raw-html:`<br />`

**Connection:** :raw-html:`<br />`
*Discharge Port:* XT90 / 10AWG :raw-html:`<br />`
*Charge Port:* XT60 / 14AWG :raw-html:`<br />`

**Dimensions:** :raw-html:`<br />`
*Size:* L x W x H ~ 6 x 3.1 x 4.8 inches :raw-html:`<br />`

.. _battery_datasheet: https://www.hotpaxx.com/product-page/24v-20ah-40a-lithium-ion-battery
